initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: Hey! You're back!

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Yeah, I thought I could use a little break

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: Have you gone into the portals yet?

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: I did, how did those portals get there?

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: I don't know...

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: But I want to figure it out!

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Really?

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Well good luck on your hunt

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: Thanks!

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: You know, I found this weird thing on the ground...

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: I don't know what it is, but I'd be willing to give it to you

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: But I uhh don't trust you with it yet

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: If you can prove yourself capable enough...

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: I'll give it to you!

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Let's see if you can travel 100,000ft!

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: 100,000 feet!? That's a lot...

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Feet? I didn't say anything about feet...

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: ft is slang for french fries

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: What's up with the T then?

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: I don't know, I didn't make the units of measurement

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: I guess french fries is all we know

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: That's still alot of fries dude

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Well what if it's super powerful and cool

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: okay fine

initial_dialogue.name: You
initial_dialogue.text: I'll do it!

initial_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
initial_dialogue.text: Great!

completed_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
completed_dialogue.text: Oh wow, I didn't actually expect you to do it...

completed_dialogue.name: You
completed_dialogue.text: Well yeah, I really wanna see what you have

completed_dialogue.name: Wise Crow
completed_dialogue.text: Oh yeah, it's just this necklace I found
